Kageaki"..."

Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"...Bhai..."
Kageaki"What?"
Chachamaru"After all that work... some words from your side would be nice, no?"
Kageaki"Words."
Chachamaru"'Good work.' 'Bad work.' 'Apun, you are a valuable colleague.' Something human."
Kageaki"Ah..."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Very well. The work is finished. Get out."
Chachamaru"ARE YOU A DEMON IN A GOVERNMENT JOB!?"
Chachamaru"And this is APUN'S room, bloody bastard!"
Kageaki"Toh? You wish to throw me out?"
Chachamaru"N-nooo? No such intention. Never. Absolutely."
Kageaki"Naturally."
Kageaki"If you don't want to leave, remain. Quietly, in a corner. Don't get in the way."
Chachamaru"...Yes..."
Chachamaru"Kya yaar... lately apun's treatment is becoming extremely third-class..."
Kageaki"Is it?"
Chachamaru"YOU just made apun fight a whole mountain of files, you merciless beast! Don't speak as if somebody has told you the news from another district!"
Kageaki"That was hardly cruel. You were pleased to be helping."
Chachamaru"Uff, uff, uff. Listen to this man. Employee welfare has died in his mouth."

en.html:
She began grumbling miserably. I ignored it and lay down for a short sleep. Her voice could enter one ear and leave by the other; no need to accommodate it between them. Even a lullaby would demand more attention.

A suitable amount of tiredness was there. Sound sleep seemed possible.

en.html:
Her conclusion was correct. I was ready in every respect. That was the only fact requiring my attention.

Kageaki Minato was now specialized for protecting Hikaru Minato.

The impurities had been thrown out. No doubt remained inside me; such freshness it gave. I was even starting to forget that doubts had ever lived there. Unpleasant tenants. Good that they had vacated.

To fulfill that single wish, anything I could do.
Without so much as a ripple disturbing my mind.

Her conclusion was correct. I was ready in every respect. That was the only fact requiring my attention.

Kageaki Minato was now specialized for protecting Hikaru Minato.

The impurities had been thrown out. No doubt remained inside me; such freshness it gave. I was even starting to forget that doubts had ever lived there. Unpleasant tenants. Good that they had vacated.

To fulfill that single wish, anything I could do.
Without so much as a ripple disturbing my mind.

　今の俺は万全であり、それだけが意味のある事実だ。

　湊斗景明は湊斗光を守る為に特化されている。

　不純物は体外へ排泄された。
　清々しさを覚える程、いま俺の内面には迷いという
ものが無い。<ruby>嘗<rt>かつ</rt></ruby>てそんなものがあったことすら、良く
思い出せなくなりつつある。

　唯ひとつの望みを遂げる為なら、俺は如何なる所業
でも成し得るだろう。
　心に波風を立てる事さえなく。

Then the two of us met."Kageaki"...?"Chachamaru"Accept that it exists... then all that remains is to bring it out."Chachamaru"God will come, bhai."Kageaki"..."Kageaki"Rubbish."Chachamaru"Even a new religious sect would make a better recruitment speech, no? With this pitch, not one devotee is coming."Kageaki"...Still, I shall go along. If that idiotic dream is the only hope of keeping Hikaru alive."Kageaki"If her survival can only be fantasy now, toh reality can get out. I shall break it and put the fantasy in its place."Kageaki"Whatever in this world tries to stop me."Chachamaru"————"

茶々丸「神に・・。 　人を超えた存在に生まれ変わらせる」
茶々丸「本人が望む通り」
景明「…………」
茶々丸「相変わらず、与太話にしか聞こえねーって 顔ですね」
景明「与太話にしか聞こえん」
茶々丸「あの論文読んでも？」
景明「余計に疑わしくなったくらいだ。 　この地面の下に神がいる・・・・・・・・・・・、だと？」
景明「信じろと言う方がどうかしている」
茶々丸「はっはっはー。ごもっとも。 　だいたい、タイトルからして『劒冑夢想・・論』 だしね。書いた当時は筆者自身が内容をろく すっぽ信じてなかったって代物だ」
景明「……」
茶々丸「でも……今は違う。 　地の底深くに眠るものの実在は確信されて いる」
茶々丸「神を推論するあいつと、神を感受するあて が出会ったから」
景明「……？」
茶々丸「実在を認めたなら…… 　後は引っ張り出すだけ」
茶々丸「神は来るよ。お兄さん」
景明「…………」
景明「与太話だな」
茶々丸「そこいらの新興宗教だってもう少しましな 勧誘するよねー。 　これじゃ信者は集まらんわー」
景明「……だが、乗ってやる。 　その愚にもつかん夢物語だけが光を生かす 希望なら」
景明「つまりは光の存命がもはや空想でしか有り 得ないというのなら―― 　現実を叩き壊して空想を後釜に据えてやる」
景明「この世の何が邪魔をしようともだ」
茶々丸「――――」

That was what I would do. Bas.

For that alone I existed.

Chachamaru"...There."
Kageaki"————"
Chachamaru"Hehe."
Kageaki"What was that, suddenly?"
Chachamaru"A salute of loyalty."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"You are my master, bhai. If you fight the world, apun will be the blade—the force—you wield against it."
Chachamaru"Sword, shield, gun. Whatever you need, I'll become it and help."
Kageaki"Chachamaru."
Chachamaru"So... together, haan, bhai?"
Chachamaru"All the way to the end of the world."
Kageaki"...Yes..."
